title: Fix 'A stop job is running for User Manager' during shutdown
summary: Address a slow shutdown caused by a user service not stopping in time. You can identify the problematic service or reduce the global timeout.

aliases.text: stop job is running for user manager

error_patterns: A stop job is running for User Manager for UID

steps.explain: To find which service is causing the delay, start a debug shell and check jobs during the hang.
Reboot or shut down. When the message appears, switch to the debug shell (Ctrl+Alt+F9) and run this command to see pending jobs.
Open the editor for the service override. Add [Service] and TimeoutStopSec=1s to force it to stop quickly.

placeholders.name: SERVICE_NAME
placeholders.description: Name of the misbehaving user service

rollback.explain: Remove the override file for the service.

warnings: Setting TimeoutStopSec too low may cause data corruption if the application needs time to save state.
